Generated Narrative: CodeSystem eu-ai-human-oversight-cs

This case-sensitive code system http://example.org/fhir/eu-ai-transparency/CodeSystem/eu-ai-human-oversight-cs defines the following codes:

CodeDisplayDefinition
human-validation Human ValidationA human reviewer assessed the AI output and accepted it without changing its substantive content.
human-override Human OverrideA human reviewer rejected the AI output or recommendation.
human-correction Human CorrectionA human reviewer corrected erroneous or incomplete AI-generated content while retaining the corrected result as the documented outcome.
